coverageGaps: Scoped patch/modifier helpers omit calls outside recorded paired intervals. Inline guards remain outside named IsPatched coverage.
Int32-backed application enums retain all 32 return bits; they are never observed through a Boolean ABI.
Assign/AddRange/list restoration intervals and their reached per-item submissions are distinct from a final collection snapshot. Empty AddRange and inlined mutations may have no per-item records.
Healing encode/parse phase snapshots preserve populated fields when present. Source/target/amount/HP zeros remain values, not proof of a completed settlement or transport direction.

Public protobuf WriteTo/Input MergeFrom bodies are folded across message types and are omitted. Only uniquely owned internal codec entries may observe HealDetail fields; context byrefs remain opaque pointers.
Normal concrete value-type method receivers point at unboxed data, not boxed objects. Explicit receiver size/field witnesses prevent a second object header offset.
IFix.WrappersManagerImpl occurs in multiple metadata images. Gameplay observers bind Gameplay.Beyond.dll explicitly; an idle same-name helper from another image is not live patch evidence.

CompareFloat uses GetValueOrDefault/GetDoubleValueOrDefault and generic TryGetValue, bypassing the named GetDouble route. Helper entries preserve expression fields but do not observe XMM2 default input, helper return or generic success.
OnCreate captures data/patch/extra object identities and output identities. Closed generic base/patch List identities are omitted rather than admitted through an unproved reference witness.

Named IFix decisions are recorded only under a paired ancestor and at selected direct caller return sites in initialization, comparison and healing bodies. Other callers and inline guards remain unobserved; absence outside this filter is collection policy.

Healing attribute snapshot reads and interest/dispatch/action-container entries are observed at named filtered sites. Generic delegate subscriber enumeration, full attribute modifier sources and server acknowledgement remain separate.
